now.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
now.text: Dogpool points Wade and Logan to the Void's resistance, and later joins Wade's friends at home.

proposed.text: Nicepool's dog Dogpool charms Wade in the Void, and after Nicepool dies she stays with Wade and his friends at home.

changes.evidence: In Deadpool & Wolverine, Dogpool (Mary Puppins) is Nicepool's pet; she runs up to Wade and Logan as they leave Joe's Diner, and Nicepool lends them his car. She doesn't point them to the resistance. Wade adopts her after Nicepool is killed on Earth-10005.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
now.text: In episode 5, Ayo's Dora Milaje come for Zemo, beat John Walker in a fight, and later take Zemo to the Raft.

proposed.text: In episode 4, Ayo's Dora Milaje come for Zemo, beat John Walker in a fight, and later take Zemo to the Raft.

changes.evidence: Per the FATWS episode summaries, the Dora Milaje come for Zemo and humiliate Walker in episode 4 ('The Whole World Is Watching'). Episode 5 is only where Bucky hands Zemo over, so the record starts in episode 4.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
now.text: In episode 4, Bucky breaks Zemo out of prison to help track the super soldier serum, and Zemo joins him and Sam in hunting the Flag Smashers.

proposed.text: In episode 3, Bucky breaks Zemo out of prison to help track the super soldier serum, and Zemo joins him and Sam in hunting the Flag Smashers.

changes.evidence: Bucky stages the prison riot that frees Zemo in episode 3 ('Power Broker'), and they then go on to Madripoor and Riga. The record says episode 4.

now.title: Ms. Marvel
now.text: In episode 5, Hasan marries Aisha, loses her during the 1947 Partition, and is reunited with their daughter Sana.

changes.evidence: Ms. Marvel episode 5 ('Time and Again') shows Hasan's rose farm, his marriage and the Partition train station in British India, where he gets on the last train to Pakistan. None of it takes place in Karachi. If the app has an India place, use it instead of leaving this empty.

now.title: I Am Groot
now.text: In episode 3, Baby Groot plays with the tiny Grunds and ejects a shape-shifting alien from the ship.

proposed.text: In episode 3, Baby Groot dances with a shape-shifting alien that copies him, then ejects it from the ship.

changes.evidence: The Grunds are in episode 2 ('The Little Guy'). Episode 3 ('Groot's Pursuit') is the one with the shape-shifter Iwua, who dances with Groot until he ejects it through the airlock.

owner_calls.question: Record k0 is labeled 'In episode 3' but sums up episodes 1 to 3 (Crete in ep 1, Troy in ep 2, K'un-Lun in ep 3). Keep it as a show-wide summary, or relabel or split it?
options: Drop the 'In episode 3,' prefix so it reads as a whole-show summary
Split into one record per episode
owner_calls.evidence: Eyes of Wakanda: ep 1 'Into the Lion's Den' is set in 1260 BC Crete, ep 2 'Legends and Lies' is at Troy, ep 3 'Lost and Found' is at K'un-Lun.
